items.title: Overview directory is fixed
items.summary: `docs/project/overview/` may contain only `instructions.md`, `project.md`, `goal.md`. No other files/subdirs.

items.title: Ideas are on-request only
items.summary: Do not read/cite `docs/ideas/` unless user explicitly asks for a specific idea file.

items.title: Exclude ENGINE-only attributes from Narrator context
items.summary: Re-filter retrieved attributes before assembling the Narrator prompt so attributes visible only to ENGINE never enter Narrator context.
